channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Government rolls out free HIV prevention medicines PEP and PrEP
item.description: Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela says Malta is aligned with UNAIDS goals to end AIDS as a public health threat by 2030

item.title: Conflicting expert testimony raises doubts over drug evidence in 2013 case
item.description: New court expert testimony raises fresh questions over drug evidence on a long-running criminal case, with defence arguing the substance allegedly seized more than a decade ago no longer shows any traces of drugs

item.title: Consumers warned of toxic chemicals in NaturalSi hulled millet packages
item.description: NaturaSi’s organic hulled millet packages have been recalled and found to contain toxic levels of Tropane Alkaloids.

item.title: Desire & Its Excess: Lawrence Buttigieg’s new solo exhibition
item.description: Lawrence Buttigieg’s latest exhibition at Spazju Kreattiv, Desire & Its Excess, offers a multi-layered investigation into the nature of desire and the forms of creativity it provokes

item.title: Accused granted bail after admitting to threatening man
item.description: The accused pleaded guilty to threatening communications but was granted bail, as the court imposed multiple conditions and deferred sentencing

item.title: Joseph Portelli eyes five-storey block instead of old pasta factory in Balzan
item.description: Developer Joseph Portelli is proposing a five-storey residential and commercial block in place of the Macaroni Premier factory on Triq in-Naxxar in Balzan

item.title: San Ġwann battery factory goes up in flames
item.description: Civil Protection Malta is responding to an industrial fire in San Ġwann, with emergency teams on the scene working to contain the blaze • Residents in nearby areas, including San Ġwann and Swatar, have been advised to keep all doors and windows closed as a precaution against smoke and fumes

item.title: Man wanted in Europe is charged with drug and money laundering offences
item.description: Court hears how man who is wanted against a European Arrest Warrant made thousands off drugs and money laundering

item.title: European Union lists Iran’s IRGC as terrorist organisation
item.description: European Union designates Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organisation, along with its subsidiary forces, the Quds Force and the Basij

item.title: Andy Ellul announces imminent NAO investigation into Malita Investments
item.description: XTRA on TVM | Parliamentary Secretary Andy Ellul announces imminent National Audit Office investigation into Malita Investments plc’s operations following allegations levelled against the state-owned company’s operations over the past months
